tortoise._comment: HTTP transport — the DB target is resolved SERVER-SIDE by whichever process listens on localhost:8000 (hosted API via entrypoint.sh → FALKORDB_CLOUD_URI, or selfhost daemon via TORTOISE_DB_URI). The old stdio command+env pattern (python3 -m tortoise.mcp_server with TORTOISE_DB_URI in env) was replaced in feat/338 (commit 6ea920f). See how-to-use-tortoise skill §DB URI Reality for full env precedence.
